title: Ford 4.9L · engine atlas
status: In-progress reconstruction; not a complete or verified OEM engine

definitions.name: Piston
definitions.function: Receives combustion force at the crown and transfers it through the wrist pin. D-shaped dish, underside and ring grooves are modeled; skirt profile and pin offset remain provisional.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Wrist pin
definitions.function: Connects piston and rod at their small-end joint. Retainer configuration and offset need confirmation.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Top compression ring
definitions.function: Seals combustion gases and transfers heat toward the bore. Individual split ring; exact section profile is not yet reconstructed.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Oil-control rail 1
definitions.function: One of two thin rails in the provisional three-piece oil-control pack.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Oil-ring expander
definitions.function: Loads the oil rails outward. A split band represents this component; actual corrugations and oil-drain windows remain unmodeled.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Connecting rod
definitions.function: Transfers force between wrist pin and crank journal. Its angle is solved from the mechanism; center distance and forging profile are provisional.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Rod cap
definitions.function: Closes the big end around the crank journal and lower bearing shell.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Upper bearing shell
definitions.function: Supports the loaded side of the crank-journal interface. Separate from the rod forging.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Lower bearing shell
definitions.function: Fits inside the removable cap. Oil film is an explanation, not a fluid simulation.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Rod bolt 1
definitions.function: Clamps the cap to the rod. Smooth-shank placeholder; thread, grade and dimensions remain unverified.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Rod nut 1
definitions.function: Retains its cap bolt. Threads and locking details are not yet modeled.
unresolved: Inherited piston-study assumptions; exact forging, ring profiles, pin offset and fastener threads remain unresolved.

definitions.name: Crankshaft
definitions.function: Six throws turn reciprocating piston force into rotation. The seven main journals support the shaft; paired throws follow the 1–5–3–6–2–4 firing order.
unresolved: Journal widths, axial stations, counterweight contours, fillets, oil drillings and flange holes remain provisional.

definitions.name: Cylinder block
definitions.function: Holds six cylinder bores, seven crankshaft supports and the cam-side structure. The visible water space is a simplified cast cavity, not a traced coolant network.
unresolved: Bore pitch 113.792 mm, deck height 254 mm and casting envelope are assumptions. Water jackets, oil drillings, bosses, plugs and deck passages need reconstruction.

definitions.name: Main bearing cap
definitions.function: Closes the crankshaft main bearing bore beneath the block. Each installed cap must retain its original position and orientation.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Upper main bearing shell
definitions.function: A replaceable bearing surface carries the crankshaft on a pressurized oil film. Thrust-bearing details remain unresolved.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Lower main bearing shell
definitions.function: A replaceable bearing surface carries the crankshaft on a pressurized oil film. Thrust-bearing details remain unresolved.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Main cap bolt
definitions.function: Clamps a main cap to the cylinder block. Smooth shank; thread and grade are not modeled.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Cylinder head
definitions.function: Closes the cylinders and carries the valves, intake and exhaust passages and rocker supports. Port and chamber shapes here are provisional.
unresolved: Chamber volume/profile, port routing, coolant passages, casting numbers, guides and exact valve/rocker stations remain unverified.

definitions.name: Head gasket
definitions.function: Seals combustion, coolant and oil interfaces between block and head. Fire rings and passage pattern need further evidence.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Cylinder head bolt
definitions.function: One of fourteen fasteners in the factory head-bolt tightening sequence. Exact shank lengths and threads are pending.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Intake Valve
definitions.function: Opens its port at the appropriate part of the four-stroke cycle and seals against the head when closed. Stem, face and keeper groove are separate features in one valve.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Exhaust Valve
definitions.function: Opens its port at the appropriate part of the four-stroke cycle and seals against the head when closed. Stem, face and keeper groove are separate features in one valve.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Valve spring
definitions.function: Returns the valve to its seat and keeps the valvetrain in contact with the cam profile. Coil count, rate and installed height are provisional.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Valve spring retainer
definitions.function: Captures the top of the spring; paired keepers lock it to the valve stem.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Valve keeper half
definitions.function: One half of the split lock connecting the spring retainer to the valve stem. Taper and lock profile are provisional.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Valve stem seal
definitions.function: Limits oil passing down the valve guide into the port. Seal construction and exact application remain unverified.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Hollow pushrod
definitions.function: Transfers lifter motion to the rocker and provides an oil route to the rocker interface. Length and end geometry are provisional.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Rocker arm
definitions.function: Pivots on its fulcrum: a rising pushrod pushes the opposite end down against the valve. Stamped contours and exact leverage remain provisional.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Rocker fulcrum
definitions.function: Provides the pivot bearing under the rocker attachment bolt.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Rocker attachment bolt
definitions.function: Retains the fulcrum on the threaded head pedestal.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Fulcrum guide
definitions.function: Locates the fulcrum on its head pedestal; the factory diagram identifies it as a separate component.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Hydraulic lifter body
definitions.function: Rides the cam lobe and houses the hydraulic lash-adjusting components. Separate retaining-ring groove, annular oil-feed groove and radial oil port are modeled; their dimensions are provisional.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Lifter plunger
definitions.function: Moves inside the body to take up valve-train clearance. Its bottom closes the hydraulic chamber around the small check-valve port.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Lifter plunger spring
definitions.function: Biases the plunger outward during lash adjustment.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Lifter check valve
definitions.function: Closes the oil chamber during lift so the lifter transmits force.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Lifter check-valve spring
definitions.function: Biases the check valve toward its seat.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Lifter check-valve retainer
definitions.function: Retains the check-valve spring at the plunger base.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Lifter metering disc
definitions.function: Meters the oil delivered toward the pushrod cup.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Lifter pushrod cup
definitions.function: Supports the spherical pushrod end and admits lubricating oil.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Lifter retaining ring
definitions.function: Keeps the internal parts inside the lifter body.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Camshaft
definitions.function: Twelve lobes time the intake and exhaust valves. Four bearing journals locate the shaft; the timing gears turn it once per two crankshaft revolutions.
unresolved: Lobe profiles, timing events, distributor drive, journal sizes and axial positions are not yet reconstructed.

definitions.name: Camshaft bearing
definitions.function: Supports a camshaft journal in the block. Oil feed holes and individual bearing sizes require verification.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Crank Timing Gear
definitions.function: The direct gear mesh maintains a 2:1 crank-to-cam speed ratio. These are 20-degree involute teaching gears; tooth count and pitch are not verified for the truck.
unresolved: Exact tooth count, pressure angle, material and timing-mark stations are unverified.

definitions.name: Cam Timing Gear
definitions.function: The direct gear mesh maintains a 2:1 crank-to-cam speed ratio. These are 20-degree involute teaching gears; tooth count and pitch are not verified for the truck.
unresolved: Exact tooth count, pressure angle, material and timing-mark stations are unverified.

definitions.name: Timing cover
definitions.function: Encloses the gear drive and carries the front crankshaft seal. Casting profile, mounting pattern and water-pump interface remain provisional.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Front crankshaft seal
definitions.function: Seals around the rotating front crankshaft snout. The lip is represented by a simple annular solid.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Rear crankshaft seal
definitions.function: Limits oil leakage at the rear crankshaft exit. Seal lip and housing fit need exact dimensions.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Oil pan
definitions.function: Stores the engine oil beneath the crankcase. The sump profile, baffles and pickup clearance need truck-specific references.
unresolved: This is an envelope study; the truck sump contour and all baffles are not yet modeled.

definitions.name: Oil pan side gasket 1
definitions.function: Seals one side of the sump flange. Separate end seals remain missing; exact truck gasket construction needs confirmation.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Oil pan side gasket 2
definitions.function: Seals one side of the sump flange. Separate end seals remain missing; exact truck gasket construction needs confirmation.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Valve cover
definitions.function: Contains oil around the rocker gear and provides the oil-fill and ventilation interfaces. Stamping ribs and PCV openings are pending.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Valve cover gasket
definitions.function: Seals the rocker cover to the head. Bolt-hole pattern and corner radii are pending.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.

definitions.name: Oil filler cap
definitions.function: Closes the oil-fill opening in the valve cover. Retention features are provisional.
unresolved: Exact production contours, dimensions and tolerances need applicable drawings or measurements.
